cards.definition: to discuss something in order to reach an agreement

examples.text: The two sides met to negotiate a new deal.
Her lawyer helped negotiate the contract terms.

cards.definition: a group of people chosen to manage a company or organization

examples.text: She was elected to the board of directors last year.
The board meeting was moved to Friday afternoon.

cards.definition: an amount taken off the usual price of something

examples.text: Members receive a special discount on all online orders.
The store will offer a discount during the holiday sale.

cards.definition: an act of traveling from one place to another

examples.text: They were tired after the long journey home.
We wished the travelers a safe journey abroad.

cards.definition: the condition of the atmosphere, such as rain, sun, or wind

examples.text: The flight was delayed because of bad weather.
Check the weather forecast before you travel tomorrow.

cards.definition: truthful and not likely to lie, cheat, or steal.

examples.text: Everyone trusts him because he is an honest man.
Please be honest with me about the cost.

cards.definition: to make something better or become better

examples.text: New software can improve efficiency across the whole team.
They changed suppliers to improve the quality of products.

cards.definition: to choose something after thinking about it

examples.text: They finally decided on a name for the baby.
The board decided against raising prices this year.

cards.definition: to succeed in doing something difficult

examples.text: She managed to finish the report on time.
The box is heavy, but I can manage it.

cards.definition: to say what someone or something is like

examples.text: Witnesses described the thief as tall and thin.
Please describe the problem in detail for us.

cards.definition: very old; from a time long ago in history

examples.text: People used simple tools like these in ancient times.
Tourists visit the ancient city every summer.

cards.definition: wanting to know or learn about something

examples.text: The children were curious about the new teacher.
Young kids are naturally curious about everything around them.
